# SmartSubs Pro

> AI-powered word-by-word animated subtitles and 90+ language auto-translate plugin built directly inside DaVinci Resolve (Free & Studio versions).

## Overview
SmartSubs Pro is a native plugin for DaVinci Resolve (Windows & macOS, including Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3) that generates viral, animated word-by-word captions (TikTok / Reels / Shorts style) and provides automatic multi-language translation without leaving DaVinci Resolve.

- **Official Website:** https://smartsubspro.com
- **Pricing:** One-time payment (No subscriptions), lifetime license.
- **Compatibility:** DaVinci Resolve Free & Studio (v16 through v19+).
- **Supported OS:** Windows 10/11 & macOS (Intel & Apple Silicon ARM64).

## Key Features
- **Offline Speech-to-Text (Whisper AI):** 100% offline local transcription powered by OpenAI Whisper models (Tiny, Small, Medium, Large). Privacy-first, zero cloud latency, no credit consumption for base transcription.
- **Dynamic Emphasis & Multimodal AI (Gemini AI):** Listens to pitch, volume, and speech intonation to identify true emotional emphasis and automatically highlight "Power Words" in Fusion Text+ graphics.
- **90+ Language Auto-Translate:** Translates transcripts automatically directly inside Resolve timeline using AI translation models.
- **Native Fusion Text+ Integration:** Generates native DaVinci Resolve Text+ clips and presets (`Sub_Simple` and `Sub_Hook`), allowing full keyframe, font, color, stroke, shadow, and animation customization within Resolve.
- **Silence & Punctuation Slicing:** Smart silence detection (>0.4s pause) and punctuation splitting to ensure perfect cadence matching human speech.
